categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of integrated multifunctional display and control equipment for military helicopters. Key products include airborne multifunctional display control devices and embedded computer modules, mainly serving military helicopter applications. Additionally, the company engages in high-reliability electronic modules, special vehicles, visualization navigation products, ground support equipment, and Beidou communication devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary video processing and integrated testing technologies, emphasizing modular, integrated, and intelligent design of avionics systems. Production follows lean, just-in-time, and efficient manufacturing principles, with core processes like system integration, R&D, procurement, assembly, and quality control managed internally, while non-core processes such as welding and testing are outsourced under strict military standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The main customers are large state-owned military industrial groups and their subsidiaries, with the ultimate end users being the military. The company holds a dominant market share in military helicopter onboard multifunctional display equipment in China and also supplies to fixed-wing aircraft, special vehicles, and naval platforms. The customer base is highly concentrated, with over 97% of sales to top five customers, primarily military industrial enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are concentrated entirely within China, with no significant overseas revenue reported. Key operational sites include Beijing and Xi'an, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the military aerospace supply chain, focusing on the design, integration, and production of avionics equipment that is supplied to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) who then deliver complete systems to the military end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating and expanding market leadership in helicopter multifunctional display products, advancing military avionics with integrated visual navigation and 3D digital mapping technologies, and expanding into fixed-wing aircraft and diversified military platforms. The company emphasizes autonomous innovation, collaboration with research institutes, talent development, and continuous R&D investment to enhance product performance and market share.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of military avionics products and related technical services to military industrial group subsidiaries. The company follows a production-to-order model with sales recognized upon delivery and acceptance. Technical service contracts and after-sales support also contribute to revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier and holds a dominant position in the Chinese military helicopter multifunctional display equipment market. It is recognized as a main supplier with stable product quality and strong customer service, receiving multiple military commendations. Competition is limited due to high industry entry barriers and the company's early-mover advantage and comprehensive military qualifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 180 million, a 320% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 26.7 million, up nearly 116%. The company has shown strong recovery and growth following prior years' adjustments and maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 1.4 billion. R&D investment remains significant, accounting for over 26% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly reliable, low-failure-rate multifunctional display control systems tailored for military helicopters, emphasizing modularity, integration, and intelligent human-machine interfaces. Its products reduce pilot workload, improve operational efficiency, and meet stringent military standards. The company’s early adoption of proprietary technologies, comprehensive military certifications, and strong customer relationships differentiate it as a trusted supplier in the defense avionics sector.
